outcome.shown:
1. State your main point in the subject line and the very first sentence of the message so the reader instantly knows what the email is about.
2. Use bullet points and short paragraphs to break up text and make key information easy to scan quickly.
3. End with a clear, specific call to action that tells the recipient exactly what steps to take next.
